title: Rust: Rule 1 compression
description: Implement Rule 1 compression in Rust. Acceptance: compresses full IPv6/UDP headers, passes same vectors as Python.
close_reason: Rust SCHC Rule 1 (Yggdrasil IPv6+UDP+CoAP, rule_id=1) compress is implemented in rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs compress()/compress_coap with RULE_GLOBAL_COAP. Shared oracle test/vectors/schc_compression.json vector coap_global. cargo test -p lichen-schc --test shared_vectors test_schc_compression_vectors passed.
